query:
SELECT 
  j.status, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT j.id) as total_journals,
  COUNT(ae.id) as total_entries,
  js.sourceType,
  COUNT(DISTINCT js.sourceId) as total_sources
FROM journals j 
LEFT JOIN accountingEntries ae ON ae.journalId = j.id
LEFT JOIN journalSources js ON js.journalId = j.id
WHERE j.competenceMonth = '2026-01' 
GROUP BY j.status, js.sourceType
ORDER BY j.status, js.sourceType;
